acceptanceCriteria: EN: apps/goods-garden-cli/src/main.rs gains a new seven-day-life subcommand that scripts seven synthetic days (at least two of which raise a Need/Care Request answered by synthetic Human Feedback, each followed by a verification day) using only existing goods-domain/goods-application/goods-runtime types; the existing demo subcommand's behavior and output are unchanged. JA: apps/goods-garden-cli/src/main.rs に新しい seven-day-life subcommand を追加し、既存の goods-domain/goods-application/goods-runtime の型だけを使って7日分の synthetic day（うち少なくとも2日は synthetic Human Feedback で応答される Need/Care Request を発生させ、それぞれ verification day が続く）をスクリプト化する。既存の demo subcommand の挙動と出力は変更しない。ZH: apps/goods-garden-cli/src/main.rs 新增 seven-day-life 子命令，仅使用既有的 goods-domain/goods-application/goods-runtime 类型编排七个 synthetic day（其中至少两天引发由 synthetic Human Feedback 回应的 Need/Care Request，且各自后跟一个验证日）；既有 demo 子命令的行为与输出保持不变。

EN: A new phase_6_seven_day_life.rs test runs the compiled CLI with the seven-day-life argument and asserts the output contains markers for at least one anomaly day, its Care Request/Care Action, a follow-up Outcome/Learning line, and a final memory tally, without changing phase_1_demo.rs, phase_2_need.rs, phase_3_care.rs, phase_4_memory.rs or phase_5_learning.rs. JA: 新設の phase_6_seven_day_life.rs がコンパイル済み CLI を seven-day-life 引数で実行し、少なくとも1つの anomaly day とその Care Request/Care Action、follow-up の Outcome/Learning 行、最終的な memory 集計を含むことを検証する。既存5つのテストファイルは変更しない。ZH: 新增的 phase_6_seven_day_life.rs 以 seven-day-life 参数运行编译后的 CLI，并断言输出包含至少一个异常日及其 Care Request/Care Action、后续 Outcome/Learning 行以及最终 memory 汇总；不修改既有五个测试文件。

EN: docs/phases/phase-6-seven-day-life.md, docs/architecture/domain-model.md and docs/README.md are updated in English, Japanese and Chinese, and a PROPOSED design spec is recorded under docs/superpowers/specs/. JA: docs/phases/phase-6-seven-day-life.md、docs/architecture/domain-model.md、docs/README.md を英語・日本語・中文で更新し、docs/superpowers/specs/ に PROPOSED の設計 spec を記録する。ZH: 以英文、日语、中文更新 docs/phases/phase-6-seven-day-life.md、docs/architecture/domain-model.md 与 docs/README.md，并在 docs/superpowers/specs/ 下记录 PROPOSED 设计 spec。

EN: cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, cargo run -p goods-garden-cli -- demo, cargo run -p goods-garden-cli -- seven-day-life and bash tests/architecture/check-boundaries.sh all pass. JA: 指定された Cargo quality command、両方の local demo 実行、architecture boundary check が全て通る。ZH: 指定的 Cargo quality command、两个本地 demo 运行与 architecture boundary check 全部通过。
goal: EN: A person can run a new CLI subcommand and see a coherent seven-day narrative for one synthetic rice ball: calm days, at least two anomalies each raising a Care Request answered by synthetic Human Feedback, and follow-up verification showing whether each Care Action resolved the Need, ending with a memory tally. The existing demo subcommand's output is unchanged. JA: 人が新しい CLI subcommand を実行し、1つの synthetic rice ball の一貫した7日間の narrative（平穏な日、synthetic Human Feedback で応答される Care Request を伴う少なくとも2つの anomaly、各 Care Action が Need を解決したかを示す follow-up verification、最後に memory の集計）を確認できる。既存の demo subcommand の出力は変更しない。ZH: 用户可以运行新的 CLI 子命令，看到一个 synthetic 饭团连贯的七天叙事：平静的日子、至少两次由 synthetic Human Feedback 回应 Care Request 的异常、显示每个 Care Action 是否解决了 Need 的后续验证，并以 memory 汇总结束。既有 demo 子命令的输出保持不变。
intent: EN: Demonstrate the Phase 6 Seven Day Life product milestone by scripting seven synthetic days for one Goods individual through the unchanged Phase 1-5 Observe/Assess/Need/Care/Memory/Verify/Learn loop, exercising normal, anomaly, investigation, care request, human feedback, verification and memory in a single CLI narrative, without introducing any new domain type. JA: 不変の Phase 1-5 Observe/Assess/Need/Care/Memory/Verify/Learn loop を1つの Goods individual に対して7日分の synthetic day としてスクリプト化し、normal、anomaly、investigation、care request、human feedback、verification、memory を1つの CLI narrative として示す Phase 6 Seven Day Life マイルストーンを実現する。新しい domain type は追加しない。ZH: 通过不改动的 Phase 1-5 Observe/Assess/Need/Care/Memory/Verify/Learn 循环，为一个 Goods individual 编排七个 synthetic day 的脚本，在单一 CLI 叙事中展现 normal、anomaly、investigation、care request、human feedback、verification 与 memory，实现 Phase 6 Seven Day Life 里程碑；不引入任何新的领域类型。
